pieces.Text: A witchwolf skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, a witchwolf skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to Wisdom. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time a witchwolf skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage, 2 claw attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, darkvision 60 feet, or +2 racial bonus on all saving throws. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
